Chapter 229: Chapter 19 'Update' Martial Path Evolutionary Path

Chapter 229: Chapter 19 ‘Update’ Martial Path Evolutionary Path

The Heiyu Family.

Heiyu Mo sat on the throne in the grand hall.

His gaze was deep as he looked towards the cosmic starry sky.

At his ears, a highly secretive fluctuation resounded.

“Heiyu Mo, you have infiltrated human civilization for hundreds of thousands of years.”

“All along, you have done very well, but today, you need to do one last thing.”

...

“Kill Shisan, the Peak Master.”

“That Shisan Peak Master, who has just stepped into the Sixth Rank and is the tribe’s great diviner, has confirmed that his life mark is not yet fully integrated into the universe.”

“At this time, if you kill him, he will die completely, with no possibility of resurrection.”

“If it were anyone else, even an Eighth Layer powerhouse, it wouldn’t be possible to break into Chikun Main Star and kill that Shisan Peak Master.”

“But you, Heiyu Mo, are different. You are under the command of Chikun Star Lord, and you have the right to enter Chikun Main Star.”

“Secondly, your youngest son once suppressed Shisan Peak Master. If you take your youngest son to Chikun Main Star to offer an apology, you will have a chance to meet Shisan Peak Master.”

“At that time, make your move. After calculations by the tribe’s great diviner, you have a ten percent chance of killing Shisan Peak Master.”

A series of extremely subtle vibrations entered Heiyu Mo’s ears, transforming into information he could understand.

“Kill Shisan Peak Master.”

Heiyu Mo remained silent.

He knew very well that the chances of killing Shisan Peak Master under the watchful eyes of Chikun Star Lord were exceedingly slim.

And no matter whether he succeeded in killing him or not,

He, Heiyu Mo, and the entire Heiyu Family would be doomed.

“Heiyu Mo, the talent and potential shown by Shisan Peak Master suggest that he may become a Seventh Rank Monarch, or even ascend to Eighth Layer…”

“For hundreds of thousands of years, you have been stuck at Seventh-Rank Marquis Level. If you can kill Shisan Peak Master, it will all be worth it.”

“As for the Heiyu Family you run? Considering your youngest son’s oppression of Shisan Peak Master, the downfall of the Heiyu Family is only a matter of time.”

The subtle vibration continued.

“I am not sure that I can kill Shisan Peak Master within the perceptual range of the Star Lord.”

Heiyu Mo replied.

The subtle vibration stated he had a ten percent chance of killing Shisan Peak Master.

But Heiyu Mo felt that a ten percent chance was too high; based on his understanding of the Star Lord, as long as it was on the main star, he could appear instantaneously at any location.

“Regarding this, the tribe’s great diviner is prepared. This secret technique can grant you Eighth Layer strength in an instant. As long as Chikun Star Lord is not constantly on guard against you, there is a chance of killing Shisan Peak Master.”

A subtle vibration transmitted a secret technique.

“Secret technique…”

Heiyu Mo glanced at it.

This secret technique required him to burn everything of himself.

Physical soul, life span, and potential, to gain a temporary surge in strength.

Using this secret technique, he indeed had a chance to kill Shisan Peak Master, but he would not survive afterwards.

After the event, he would die from the backlash of the secret technique without the need for any action from the Red Kun Lineage.

Heiyu Mo remained silent.

“Heiyu Mo, as long as you do as I told, whether successful or not, your tribe, your people, will be granted ten constellations as their home.”

“My Insect Race will dispatch massive resources and treasures to cultivate your people and tribe.”

The subtle vibration continued.

“I understand.”

Heiyu Mo replied softly.

…

Shortly after,

Heiyu Ao was brought into the palace.

“Father…”

Heiyu Ao’s limbs were trembling, and his lips quivered as he looked at Heiyu Mo seated on the throne.

Heiyu Mo’s expression was calm as he looked down at his youngest son.

The act of Heiyu Ao suppressing Lin Yuan was criticized by many in the Heiyu Family, but to other species, it was seen as an opportunity.

It was because of Heiyu Ao’s rashness that Heiyu Mo had the opportunity to take Heiyu Ao to meet Shisan Peak Master.

Without this incident, Heiyu Mo would have no pretext to meet Shisan Peak Master.

Forcing a meeting without reason could have likely alerted the ‘Divination’ Class Evolvers on Chikun Main Star to something unusual.

Everything in the universe follows its natural laws.

Under normal circumstances, Heiyu Mo would not need to urgently meet Shisan Peak Master; if he insisted on doing so, it would be abnormal and prompt the ‘Divination’ Class Evolvers to delve deeper.

But with Heiyu Ao, it was different.

My son once oppressed you, and now we have come here to offer apologies.

This would seem reasonable and normal.

No one could find fault with it.

…

“My tribe…”

Although Heiyu Mo appeared calm on the surface, his mind was intensely conflicted.

He came from a weak tribe deep within the star space.

The war between human civilization and the Insect Race affected the tribe where Heiyu Mo originated.

Under unavoidable circumstances, Heiyu Mo had no choice but to follow his tribe and ally with the Insect Race.

Because of his decent evolutionary talent and potential, the Insect Race arranged for him to enter the territory of human civilization.

It is fairly common for members of weak tribes like Heiyu Mo’s to occasionally drift into human civilization territory and settle down there.

Human civilization did not take too many precautions against such beings, enabling Heiyu Mo to join Chikun Star Lord and establish the formidable Heiyu Family.

Of course, due to Heiyu Mo’s foreign origin, it was impossible for him to become a high-ranking member of human civilization; establishing the Heiyu Family was already the limit.

“Father… Mother….”

Heiyu Mo’s thoughts drifted as if he had returned to hundreds of thousands of years ago when he was still a child, running across the plains with his parents.

Life was so carefree back then.

If not for the war between humans and the Insect Race, he would probably be very happy now, staying by his parents’ side, not needing to think or do anything.
